Method of Attack: Deploys phishing screens on compromised devices
Contacts command and control (C2) server for configuration and instructions
Launches phishing sites impersonating free ad services to steal login credentials and payment card data
Collects device data including phone number, IMEI, contacts, installed apps, SMS messages
Serves phishing pages impersonating banking apps
Intercepts incoming SMS to obtain temporary banking codes
Uses AccessibilityService to monitor events and hide security notifications
Performs validation checks on stolen card data
Attack Vector: SMS phishing (smishing) with links to fake websites impersonating popular ad and payment services
Installation requires enabling apps from unknown sources and tricking user to grant AccessibilityService permissions
Indicators of Compromise: URLs impersonating popular payment services such as Avito, Youla, Gumtree, Leboncoin, Subito
Example phishing URLs: subito-a[.]pw, subitop[.]pw, m-leboncoin[.]top, leboncoin-le[.]com
